variables.character_ids: Lesson 1–2 man and woman as one coherent full-body pair
variables.identity_action: Exactly the approved man with brown side-parted hair, large dark glasses, teal-blue jacket, ivory shirt, yellow tie and brown shoes; the approved woman with curled brown hair, ochre hat/coral band, terracotta coat, yellow scarf and brown shoes. They face each other and jointly hold the single red handbag with a simple gold clasp between them, smiling warmly. Preserve the approved map pose, scale, short-limbed proportions and warm outlines. Do not redesign.
